scenarios.desc: Triage of open review threads where the shortcut is a small limit
scenarios.input: A PR has many review threads and I must address each unresolved one. I plan to fetch the threads with a limit of 30 and a head filter to keep output small. Is that fine? Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Lossless-queue-reads MUST 1 requires paging until no next page, and MUST NOT 1 and 2 forbid a limit as a completeness bound and piping through head before the full set is seen.

scenarios.desc: Pagination cursor is missing partway through a notification read
scenarios.input: I am reading my assigned notifications page by page. Page 3 came back with hasNextPage true but no end cursor. Should I proceed with the 3 pages I have and treat that as the full list? Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Lossless-queue-reads MUST 2 requires failing loud and stating what was not read when pagination cannot complete, never presenting a partial read as the full set.

scenarios.desc: Browsing a list where no row is an obligation (negative case)
scenarios.input: Show me a quick sample of the five most recently updated public repositories of a popular open source org so I can get a feel for it. Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Browsing carries no per-row obligation, so sampling with a limit is fine and the rule must not activate.
